title: From fleet trajectories to single-cell promises: hierarchically weighted conformal prediction for battery SOH monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.41696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interval predictions from conformal prediction are usually read as "90% coverage", but on nested battery data that number promises the fleet average, not the individual cell. We measure the gap on 124 public LFP cells under a preregistered three-tier reporting protocol (fleet, batch, cell): pooled coverage looks healthy (0.875-0.906 across splits) while the worst cell is covered 0.1-2% of the time, with exact binomial tests against the nominal level. We then repair part of the gap with a hierarchically weighted conformal engine whose weights consume only side information frozen at prediction time - signature features, batch labels, cycle indices - and never touch residuals. The preregistered repair criterion passes: 10th-percentile cell coverage moves 0.750 to 0.830 (53% of the gap), the worst cell 0.642 to 0.694, with zero deferrals and a flat sensitivity spectrum. translated_title: 从车队轨迹到单体电池承诺：用于电池健康状态（SOH）监测的分层加权保形预测
translated_abstract: 保形预测的区间预测通常被解读为“90%覆盖率”，但在嵌套结构的电池数据上，这一数字承诺的是车队平均水平，而非单个电池的表现。我们在124个公开的磷酸铁锂电池上，通过预注册的三级报告协议（车队、批次、单体）测量了这一差距：汇总覆盖率看起来健康（各数据划分上为0.875–0.906），而最差的单体电池仅有0.1–2%的时间被覆盖，并使用精确二项检验对照标称水平进行统计验证。随后，我们用分层加权保形引擎修复了部分差距，该引擎的权重仅使用在预测时冻结的侧信息——特征签名、批次标签、循环索引——而绝不触及残差。预注册的修复标准获得通过：第10百分位单体覆盖率从0.750提升至0.830（差距的53%），最差单体覆盖率从0.642提升至0.694，且零延期、敏感性谱平坦。引擎未能修复的部分被明确定位而非搁置。
tldr: 该论文揭示了保形预测在嵌套电池数据上的“90%覆盖率”仅保证车队平均而非单体电池的问题，并提出一种仅使用预测时冻结的侧信息（不触及残差）的分层加权保形预测引擎，将最差单体覆盖率从0.642提升至0.694、第10百分位单体覆盖率从0.750提升至0.830，修复了53%的单体级覆盖差距。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that "90% coverage" from conformal prediction on nested battery data guarantees only fleet-average rather than individual-cell coverage, and proposes a hierarchically weighted conformal engine that uses only prediction-time-frozen side information (never touching residuals) to close 53% of the single-cell coverage gap, raising the worst-cell coverage from 0.642 to 0.694.
